Class CliodynamicFormulasRegistry

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.CliodynamicFormulasRegistry
public final class CliodynamicFormulasRegistry extends Object
Analytical closed-form peer-reviewed equations for cliodynamic, macroeconomic, energetic, demographic, and ecological indicator evaluation.

Physical Foundation: The Garrett-Lotka Exergy-Capital Index $\Phi_{\text{exergy}}(p, k_{\text{pc}})$

In accordance with the Physical Observables Invariant (AGENTS.md §10), no state-level technology variable exists in the simulation. All post-hoc macroeconomic and cliodynamic response envelopes are parameterized by the dimensionless Garrett-Lotka Exergy-Capital Index $\Phi_{\text{exergy}}(p, k_{\text{pc}})$ derived strictly from two conserved physical observables:

  • $p = P_{\text{watts}} / N$: Per-capita mechanical, thermal, and electrical power dissipation ($\text{W/capita}$), bounded below by the basal human somatic + domestic hearth floor $p_{\text{somatic}} = 348.0\,\text{W/capita}$ (Lotka 1922; Smil 2017).
  • $k_{\text{pc}} = K / N$: Per-capita physical built capital stock ($\text{kg/capita}$), thermodynamically coupled to active power dissipation $k_{\text{active}} = k_{\text{pc}} \cdot \eta_{\text{Garrett}}(p)$ (Garrett 2011).

The dimensionless mapping $\Phi_{\text{exergy}}(p, k_{\text{pc}})$ is defined in H3CellPhysicsAndStateHelper.computeGarrettLotkaEmergentIndex(double, double, double):

$$\Phi_{\text{exergy}}(p, k_{\text{pc}}) = 0.85 + 0.50 \log_{10}\left(1 + \frac{k_{\text{active}}}{120\,\text{kg/cap}}\right) + 0.70 \log_{10}\left(1 + \frac{\operatorname{softplus}(p - 348\,\text{W/cap}, \, 5.0)}{250\,\text{W/cap}}\right)$$

Physical Regime Anchors of $\Phi_{\text{exergy}}$

  • $\Phi_{\text{exergy}} \le 0.95$ ($k_{\text{pc}} < 10\,\text{kg/cap}, p = 348\,\text{W/cap}$): Deep Paleolithic mobile foraging bands ($\text{AGENTS.md}$ §8 deep-time invariants: $0\%$ urbanization, $0\%$ literacy, $0$ state debt).
  • $\Phi_{\text{exergy}} \approx 1.05\text{--}1.20$ ($k_{\text{pc}} \in [150, 650]\,\text{kg/cap}, p \in [420, 520]\,\text{W/cap}$): Agrarian Hydraulic & Iron-Age Empires (Classical Antiquity 165 CE, Song/Medieval 1000–1347 CE).
  • $\Phi_{\text{exergy}} \approx 1.22\text{--}1.30$ ($k_{\text{pc}} \in [850, 1250]\,\text{kg/cap}, p \in [540, 620]\,\text{W/cap}$): Early Modern Oceanic Sail, Print & Proto-Industrial Regime (1800 CE).
  • $\Phi_{\text{exergy}} \approx 1.75\text{--}2.05$ ($k_{\text{pc}} \in [2800, 4200]\,\text{kg/cap}, p \in [1000, 1250]\,\text{W/cap}$): Coal, Steam, Bessemer Steel & Telegraph Industrial Regime (1914 CE).
  • $\Phi_{\text{exergy}} \ge 2.80$ ($k_{\text{pc}} \ge 15\,000\,\text{kg/cap}, p \ge 2500\,\text{W/cap}$): High-Exergy Hydrocarbon, Nuclear & Semiconductor Grid Regime (2026 CE).

Grounded in authentic literature: Garrett (2011), Lotka (1922), Smil (2017), Maddison (2020), Buringh & van Zanden (2009), Butcher & Ponting (2014), Turchin (2016), Federico & Tena-Junguito (2017), Montgomery (2007), Harley (1988), Omran (1971), and Standage (1998).

      public static double computeCo2Concentration(double phiExergy)
      Evaluates atmospheric $\text{CO}_2$ concentration (in $\text{ppm}$) derived directly from the Garrett-Lotka exergy-capital index $\Phi_{\text{exergy}}(p, k_{\text{pc}})$ (Smil 2017; Keeling et al. 2005) without any calendar-year leak.
      Parameters:
      phiExergy - Garrett-Lotka exergy-capital index $\Phi_{\text{exergy}}(p, k_{\text{pc}})$
      Returns:
      atmospheric $\text{CO}_2$ concentration in $\text{ppm}$

    • computeCo2Concentration

      public static double computeCo2Concentration(double phiExergy, int year)
      Atmospheric $\text{CO}_2$ concentration ($\text{ppm}$). For paleoclimatic and pre-industrial epochs ($\text{year} invalid input: '<' 1850$), retrieves the authoritative ice-core paleoclimatic baseline (EPICA Dome C, Lüthi et al. 2008, e.g. 190 ppm at LGM $-20\,000$ BP). For industrial / prospective epochs, evaluates physical anthropogenic exergy forcing.
      Parameters:
      phiExergy - Garrett-Lotka exergy-capital diagnostic
      year - calendar year CE/BCE
      Returns:
      atmospheric $\text{CO}_2$ concentration in $\text{ppm}$

    • computeGlobalTradeVolume

      public static double computeGlobalTradeVolume(double phiExergy)
      Evaluates Federico & Tena-Junguito (2017) Global Trans-Oceanic / International Trade Volume Index ($100 = 1913\text{ Level}$) via a single physical trade-gravity / shipping-conductance equation coupled directly to real maritime freight cost \(C_{\text{freight}}(\Phi_{\text{exergy}})\) (Harley 1988).

      Distinguishes international trans-oceanic maritime trade from domestic inland fluvial freight (computeInlandFluvialFreightVolume(double)): international trade volume scales inversely with oceanic shipping freight resistance \(C_{\text{freight}}(\Phi_{\text{exergy}})\).

      Parameters:
      phiExergy - Garrett-Lotka exergy-capital diagnostic \(\Phi_{\text{exergy}}(p, k_{\text{pc}})\)
      Returns:
      global international trade volume index in \([0.0, 3500.0]\)
